skill.name: Deterrence
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to {0} consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Parry Stance</color></size>
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> at the cost of STA. While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes {1}% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to exit <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color> and perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If an enemy's attack hits shortly after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color> is released, Rover negates this attack's DMG and Stagnates nearby enemies, then gains immunity to interruptions and takes {2}% less DMG for a certain time. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Riposte Strike</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {3}</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Parry Stance</color>, consume STA to <color=Highlight>flash</color> in the input direction. Taking a hit during this <color=Highlight>flash</color> triggers a successful Dodge.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {4}</color>

skill.name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
skill.desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> to grant Resonators in the team {0}% ATK Bonus for {1}s.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down the button, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Apex Resonance</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked, which consumes {2}% <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> per second:
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to launch up to {3} consecutive attacks:
- The first <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=4}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The last <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=6}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
If the target is far when <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is cast on the ground, perform only <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro Hunt</color> instead, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and leaping into mid-air.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> in mid-air to launch up to {7} Mid-air Attacks:
- The first <SapTag=8>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=8}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- The next <SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=9}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last <SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>,  dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> upon landing to chain into <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>.
<color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color> can also be peformed by holding <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> in mid-air.
All <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> skills trigger <color=Highlight>Thunder Bane</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target and reducing the Cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> by {11}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Electric Surge</color></size>
Rover can hold up to 120 points of <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>.
Dealing DMG with Normal Attacks and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> restores <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Thunder Rage</color></size>
Rover can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color>.
Entering <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color> restores <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color>.
Dealing DMG with <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> restores <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color>.
<size=10></size>
skill.simple_desc:
<size=40><color=Title>Overshock</color></size>
At max <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> to grant Resonators in the team ATK Bonus.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Overshock</color> is cast by holding down the button, clear all <color=Highlight>Electric Surge</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Apex Resonance</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Apex Resonance</color>, <color=Highlight>Thunder Rage</color> is consumed each second, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds</color> is unlocked.

81001310.bg_description: Rover's usual outfit. This is what she wore at the beginning of her journey and what she will be wearing for the rest of it.

81011310.bg_description: Rover's uniform from a past life at Startorch Academy. The black-and-white motif, accented with gold stripes, weaves past and future together, ensuring that what has happened is remembered and what is yet to come feels within reach.

130905.desc: Hold {0} to enter a <color=Highlight>defensive stance</color>. While active, gain immunity to interruption and DMG Reduction, and continuously consume STA.
